Title: Testing Framework and Coverage
Content: Test project: Orchestrator.Tests (NUnit 4.5.1 + NSubstitute 5.3.0 + FluentAssertions 8.9.0 + Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.4.0). 221+ tests as of 2026-06-01. Test folders: AgentLog, Agents, Idempotency, Infrastructure, Logging, NodeClient (OllamaNode, LlamaCppNode — 41 tests, WorkerNode), Registry, Routing (16 RoutingServiceRegistryTests), SemanticKernel, Validation, Worker. GlobalUsings: NUnit.Framework, FluentAssertions, NSubstitute. Pattern: constructor-based setup (not [SetUp] attribute). All NUnit tests are [TestFixture]-based. No xUnit in this project.
